text:
Ellen Park: Heads-up: Quiet Heroes Week is next week (Mon-Fri). We're running a nomination kiosk + retro-snack station Thurs 11-2 aligned with mid-cycle check-ins. Need logistics for small plaques, 60 snack bags, printed "thank you" slips, and a tiny projector for the recognition loop. Budget approved up to $900. Who can handle vendor pickup and on-site setup?
Noah Rivera: I can do vendor pickup Wed morning. Which dock/address?
Ellen Park: Vendor: Harbor Supplies Dock 4, pkg QH-33. Pickup window Wed 9-11am. Please bring a dolly if possible.
Zoe Lim: I can staff the kiosk Thurs 10:30-1:30 and manage the projector content. Do we have the slide loop ready?
Ellen Park: Slide loop = 6 slides with recipient names and 1-line blurb. Keep it short. I'll DM the copy. Also need 60 printed "thank you" slips (2x3 cards) and 60 sticker seals.
Chase Wong: I can print the 2x3 slips at the office and cut them. Will need the final copy and a print count. I can also collate stickers into snack bags.
Noah Rivera: Picking up plaques and stickers Wed 9:30. I'll upload receipt and note expense code. My cell is 555-0167.
PayrollBot: Expense reminder: submit receipts within 7 days. Use expense code QUIETHEROES-2026 for plaques/snacks. Note: small non-cash swag under $25 per person is non-taxable; plaques >$25 will be taxable per payroll rules. See payroll policy: https://redwood.internal/payroll/policy :clipboard:
Zoe Lim: Let's keep awards under $25 to avoid taxable treatment. Small acrylic tokens + enamel sticker should be fine.
Ellen Park: Agreed. Switch plaques to acrylic tokens ($12 ea) and enamel stickers. Keeps us in non-taxable swag band. Also we want a manager checklist for nominations: recipient name, one-line impact, manager approval checkbox, opt-in for public post.
Chase Wong: Draft checklist: 1) Recipient full name 2) One-sentence impact 3) Manager name & approval 4) Public post consent (Y/N) 5) Preferred award (token/sticker/snack). I'll paste into the calendar event.
Noah Rivera: Vendor confirmed pickup dock and will load into my car. ETA Wed 9:30. I'll hand off to Zoe for collating.
Ellen Park: Volunteers: setup Thurs 10:00-10:30, kiosk shifts 10:30-12 and 12-2, teardown 2-2:30. Confirmed: Zoe 10:30-12:00, Chase 12:00-2:00. Need one more person for setup/teardown.
Zoe Lim: I can extend to 2:30 for teardown if needed.
Chase Wong: I'll bring a small labeler for sticker seals and a box cutter. Also can run the scanner app to digitize paper slips into the recognition drive.
Ellen Park: Perfect. Quick copy for the 2x3 card (use exactly):

```
Quiet Heroes Week
Thank you for your steady excellence. Please write a short note on the back and drop this in the recognition box.
```

Ellen Park: Short nom form link: https://redwood.internal/nom/quiet-heroes (3 fields max). We'll print a QR on the sign as well.
PayrollBot: Reminder: if any award exceeds $25 or is cash-equivalent, mark as taxable and submit PAY_REQ within 3 business days. Expense code QUIETHEROES-2026 still applies.
Noah Rivera: I'll upload pickup receipt right after pickup Wed and tag Ellen.
Zoe Lim: I'll assemble the slide loop Wed evening and attach it to the event. Can someone loan a small projector?
Chase Wong: Office AV has a spare BenQ projector. I'll reserve it for Thurs.
Ellen Park: Calendar event created: "Quiet Heroes Week - Kiosk & Retro Snacks" Thu 10:00-14:30. Packing checklist + slide draft in event. Please RSVP. Reminder: post a short blurb to managers Tue morning asking them to bring one-line blurbs for nominees during check-ins.
Zoe Lim: I'll mock the sign and QR sticker and add inclusive language examples for nominations.
Chase Wong: I'll prepare the scanner folder: /drive/recognition/quiet-heroes. Upload scanned slips same day.
Ellen Park: Thanks team! I'll post a final volunteer reminder Wed 7am and confirm teardown coverage. :sparkles:
